Gym Bag Checklist

Half the battle of a consistent gym habit is just having a packed bag by the door. This checklist covers the workout gear, the shower kit, and the little extras people forget until they're standing at the locker without a padlock. Use it as-is, or open it in Gisti to save your own version, and see the rest of our health and fitness checklists.

verified Curated by the Gisti team · Updated July 2026

Gym Bag Checklist · 18 items

  • check_box_outline_blank
    Workout clothes: a moisture-wicking top and shorts or leggings

    Sweat-wicking fabric beats cotton, which stays wet and chafes.

  • check_box_outline_blank
    Proper training shoes for your workout
  • check_box_outline_blank
    A spare pair of socks
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Water bottle

    Fill it before you leave so you're not queuing at the fountain.

  • check_box_outline_blank
    Small sweat towel for wiping down equipment and yourself
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Padlock for the locker
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Headphones, charged
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Lifting gloves or wrist straps, if you lift heavy
  • check_box_outline_blank
    A resistance band for warm-ups and activation
  • check_box_outline_blank
    A pre- or post-workout snack or protein shake

    Protein plus carbs within an hour or two of training supports recovery.

  • check_box_outline_blank
    Deodorant
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Shower kit: travel soap or body wash, shampoo, and flip-flops

    Flip-flops keep you off shared shower floors.

  • check_box_outline_blank
    A quick-dry towel for showering
  • check_box_outline_blank
    A full change of clean clothes and underwear
  • check_box_outline_blank
    A dry bag or plastic bag for sweaty clothes

    Keeps the wet kit from soaking everything else in the bag.

  • check_box_outline_blank
    Membership card or the gym app on your phone
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Hair ties or a headband
  • check_box_outline_blank
    Phone plus a charger or power bank

Frequently asked questions

What should I keep in my gym bag? expand_more

The core kit is workout clothes and shoes, a water bottle, a sweat towel, a padlock, and headphones. If you shower at the gym, add flip-flops, a shower towel, toiletries, deodorant, and a full change of clothes. A resistance band and a post-workout snack round it out.

How do I stop my gym bag from smelling? expand_more

Keep sweaty clothes in a separate dry bag or plastic bag, and empty and air out the whole bag after every session instead of leaving damp kit inside. Tossing in a small pouch of baking soda or a dryer sheet absorbs odor, and washing the bag itself every so often helps.

Should I pack my gym bag the night before? expand_more

Yes — a packed bag by the door removes the biggest excuse to skip a workout. Restock it right after each session: swap in clean clothes, refill snacks, and put your headphones back so it's always ready. Keeping duplicates of small items like a padlock and deodorant in the bag means less to remember.
